phase3.gigsHelp.en: Short local jobs. Check parole conditions with your officer. Phone numbers are never shown.
phase3.gigsHelp.draft: Dagiti apagbiit a lokal a trabaho. Kitaenyo dagiti kondision ti parole iti opisinayo.

phase3.housingHelp.en: Savings goals plus a housing-readiness plan. Groundwork does not provide housing and does not partner with providers. For local help, call 211.
phase3.housingHelp.draft: Dagiti kalat ti panagrang-ay agraman ti plano a panagsagana iti pagnaedan. Saan nga agited ti Groundwork iti pagnaedan ken saan a makikadua kadagiti agiserserbi. Para iti lokal a tulong, tawagan ti 211.

phase3.paidNote.en: Paid plan. No price has been set yet.
phase3.paidNote.draft: Awan pay ti naikeddeng a presio.

phase3.tokensHelp.draft: Awan ti kuarta a pateg dagiti token.

reentry.call211.draft: Awis 211 para kadagiti lokal a rekurso

reentry.crisisStep.en: Save these numbers now. You can also tap Need help now at the top of any screen.
reentry.crisisStep.draft: Mabalinmo met nga i-tap ti Masapul ti Tulong Ita iti ngato ti aniaman a screen.

reentry.steps.step14.en: Put every court date and check-in on a calendar
reentry.steps.step14.draft: Ikabilmo iti kalendario ti amin a petsa ti korte ken ti panag-check-in

reentry.steps.step17.en: Check your fines, fees and restitution
reentry.steps.step17.draft: Kitaenyo dagiti multa, bayad ken bayadyo

reentry.steps.step19.en: Enroll in Medicaid, and SNAP if you need it
reentry.steps.step19.draft: Agpalista iti Medicaid, ken SNAP no kasapulam dayta

reentry.steps.step7.en: Find a safe place to stay (call 211 or local housing resources)
reentry.steps.step7.draft: Mangbirok iti natalged a pagdagusan (telepono iti 211 wenno iti local housing resources)

reentry.steps.step8.en: Find food for this week (call 211 or a local food pantry)
reentry.steps.step8.draft: Mangbirok iti taraon para iti daytoy a lawas (awag iti 211 wenno iti local food pantry)

safety.relapseDraft.en: Draft — for review. Calm first steps for the first 24 hours after a slip will appear here once reviewed. You are not alone.
safety.relapseDraft.draft: Dagiti umuna nga addang iti umuna a 24 nga oras kalpasan ti panag-slip ket agparang ditoy apaman a napaliiw.

safety.vaultHelp.en: Your documents are encrypted. Paid plan feature; no price has been set yet.
safety.vaultHelp.draft: Na-encrypt dagiti dokumentoyo. Naipaay ti plano; awan pay ti naikeddeng a presio.

support.resourcesNote.en: Legal aid, treatment and transit. This directory does not cover food or housing.
support.resourcesNote.draft: Saan a mairaman iti daytoy a directory ti taraon wenno pagdagusan.

wellbeing.roughHelp.en: You are not alone. The crisis button above is always here — call or text 988, or 911 in an emergency.
wellbeing.roughHelp.draft: Saanka nga agmaymaysa. Ti emergency button iti ngato ket kanayon nga adda ditoy  ⁇  call or text 988, wenno 911 no adda emerhensia.

work.paroleNote.en: Check your parole or probation conditions with your officer before applying.
work.paroleNote.draft: Kitaenyo kadagiti opisialyo ti kasasaad ti parole wenno probationyo sakbay nga agaplikarkayo.
